source_reasoning: No public Pre/input cap was added. N=0 returns original ValidTrue empty output. A valid chunk consumes at least min(Quota,remaining)>0, so first-stage nonprogress/extent refusals are infeasible under the retained Chunk contract; these must be proved, not accepted as new input restrictions.

Quota=max4096,ceil(N/64) implies (N-1)/Quota<64 for N>0. While Position<N, Count<=Position/Quota therefore gives Count<64. Every nonfinal valid chunk consumes at least Quota; a shorter remaining extent must finish at N. Division avoids Count*Quota overflow.

First phase stores exact Start/Next and output Before/After links, with checked Natural overflow refusal before additions. Chunk pauses only after a complete original Step; original invalid-prefix grouping, strict failure and EF BF BD replacement logic are unchanged. Per-chunk versus per-step overflow checks produce the same False/empty outcome, with different possible work before refusal.

Saved array has exactly64 records. Defaults are PresentFalse and skip Chunk in explicit predicate short circuit. Completed records are written once. Bytes, Quota and ReplaceErrors remain immutable; no pointer or mutable global alias is introduced. The checked predicate binds stored Summary to the same pure DecodeChunk call used during replay.

Both sizing prefix quantifiers read scalar metadata by index only. They contain no explicit decoder/model call. The bound64 yields at most4160 metadata visits total for the two clauses. Actual implicit predicate calls/copies are compiler questions, so linear byte work is not yet an observed lowering guarantee.

Replay starts from the saved exact source position and requires identical Summary by predicate/congruence. Scalar adjacency links establish contiguous nonoverlapping output intervals, complete source coverage and final output length. It copies only initialized Chunk prefix bytes. Existing RelaxedInitialization is limited to the public result with the used-prefix invariant and final Initialized assertion.

The actual byte semantics follow by concatenating the unchanged Step outputs across complete-step chunk boundaries. This is source reasoning; the current coordinator contract does not itself state full output-byte equivalence, and no integrated equivalence proof/test is claimed.
